w.msg: A road of white frost runs west from the gate and ends at a wall of hard-packed snow that Hesk says has grown a hand's breadth a day for a week. It will not be dug. It is waiting for an answer: relight the Ember Court's beacon in its throne room, and something out there will answer.

e.msg: A vacant plot beyond the Hearth Stall, strung with paper lanterns nobody has lit. Joss can build a stall here once the Fairwarden, Marit Ostrand, has agreed to move in.
